adjudication.rationale: In packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx the list renders `value.map((field, index) => (<li key={index}> ... ))`. Items can be removed via `updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`. Using the array index as the React key means keys for all subsequent items change after a middle deletion, so React may reuse DOM nodes for different emails, which commonly manifests as input focus/cursor jumping or the wrong input retaining state. This is a real defect introduced by the diff.
